timeline.labelEn: Fatima al-Fihri founds the al-Qarawiyyin mosque and school in Fez (857–859)
timeline.labelDe: Fatima al-Fihri gründet die Moschee und Lehrstätte al-Qarawiyyin in Fès (857–859)

questions.notes: Options removed (Morocco, England or China). UNESCO and Guinness World Records cite al-Qarawiyyin in Fez as the oldest continually operating higher-learning institution; it became a state university only in 1963, so the 'oldest university' title is debated.

questions.de: Wie heißt der Ort, in dem der älteste Stadtmarathon Deutschlands stattfindet?
questions.en: Where does Germany's oldest city marathon take place?

timeline.labelEn: First Leipzig Marathon (then KMU-Marathon), Germany's oldest city marathon
timeline.labelDe: Erster Leipzig-Marathon (damals KMU-Marathon), der älteste Stadtmarathon Deutschlands

questions.notes: de.wikipedia calls Frankfurt (since 1981) the second-oldest city marathon after Leipzig (since 1977). Rival claims exist: Berlin (1974, but in the Grunewald until 1981), Frankfurt's own promotion, and Essen's Baldeneysee marathon (since 1963, not a city course).
